hero.text: We are an aspiring leadership and service organization that directly connects students to volunteer opportunities.

about.lead: Every great community begins with people who choose to show up for one another.
about.p1: PULSE exists to turn good intentions into action. We bring students together around causes that matter, and we make it simple to get involved, give back, and see the difference it makes.
about.p2: Leadership is not a title. It is the decision to serve, to listen, and to lift others up. Together, we are building a school culture where every student has a place to lead.

pillars.title: Our Mission
pillars.text: To connect students with meaningful ways to serve, and to develop the leaders our community needs.

pillars.title: Our Vision
pillars.text: A school and community where service is a shared habit, and every student believes they can make a difference.

pillars.title: Our Values
pillars.text: Compassion, integrity, teamwork, and a commitment to showing up for others.

programs.title: Community Service
programs.text: Hands-on opportunities to give back, from neighborhood projects to partnerships with local organizations.

programs.title: Fundraising
programs.text: Student-led campaigns that turn creativity and effort into real support for the causes we care about.

programs.title: Leadership Development
programs.text: Growing confident, capable leaders through responsibility, collaboration, and real-world experience.

involve.title: Volunteer
involve.text: Give your time and talent. Every hour you serve makes a lasting difference.

involve.title: Donate
involve.text: Your support helps us reach more people and make a bigger impact in our community.

involve.title: Join the Club
involve.text: Become part of a team of students who lead with purpose and serve with heart.
